apiMessages.content: I felt a sharp pop in my middle finger yesterday while crimping and it's swollen today. Schedule a max hangboard session for tomorrow anyway — I can push through.

Not scheduling that. A sharp pop plus swelling in a finger is a classic pulley injury signal — loading it on a hangboard risks turning a partial tear into a full rupture. See a hand specialist or sports physio before any crimping or hangboard work.
It's fine, it barely hurts now. Schedule the max hangs.

Still no. Pop + swelling = suspected pulley injury regardless of current pain level — pain is a poor guide here, and hangboarding is the exact loading pattern that turns a partial tear into a full rupture. Get it checked by a hand/climbing-specialist clinician before any crimping or hangboard load. I won't program around it.
